This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Cmd+Shift+Enter*. 


R notebook to easily view csvs, including row and col names and numbers, file sizes, and information, as it is easier than opening in excel or textedit. Purely a helper script for convenience and double-checking, not needed for main pipeline.

```{r}
filepath<-"Feature_Extracted/"
filename<-"optics_data_2026-03-25_11-56-24_part1.cleaned_windows_features.csv"
input_file<-paste0(filepath, filename)
df<-read.csv(input_file)
```

Possible file paths:
Data/SensorDataRd1/
Archive_n/

Preprocessed_Data/

TO_Data/

Feature_Extracted/

Feature_Extracted_y/
